LESSON: HEALING OF BLIND BARTIMAEUS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.3: Healing of Blind Bartimaeus

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Healing of Blind Bartimaeus. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: when they prayed to God for healing. How did Bartimaeus show faith in Jesus Christ?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. retell the healing of blind Bartimaeus,
2. recognise the healing power of Jesus Christ in their lives,
3. appreciate Jesus’ power over sickness and disease. The learner is guided to: God, healing of blind Bartimaeus, Bartimaeus, device, God for healing. How did Bartimaeus show faith in Jesus Christ?

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. retell the healing of blind Bartimaeus,

3. appreciate Jesus’ power over sickness and disease. The learner is guided to: God, healing of blind Bartimaeus, Bartimaeus, device, God for healing. How did Bartimaeus show faith in Jesus Christ?

How did Bartimaeus show faith in Jesus Christ?. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Healing of Blind Bartimaeus.
2. Explain Healing of Blind Bartimaeus to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: sing a song about the healing power of God,
4. Show that you can: retell the healing of blind Bartimaeus,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Healing of Blind Bartimaeus. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: when they prayed to God for healing. How did Bartimaeus show faith in Jesus Christ?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Sing a song about the healing power of God,
2. Read Mark 10:46-52 and retell the healing of blind Bartimaeus,
3. Record the role play using a digital device,

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. retell the healing of blind Bartimaeus,
2. recognise the healing power of Jesus Christ in their lives,
3. appreciate Jesus’ power over sickness and disease. The learner is guided to: God, healing of blind Bartimaeus, Bartimaeus, device, God for healing. How did Bartimaeus show faith in Jesus Christ?

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
